input.rationale: The Agreement contains no indemnification, defence or hold-harmless language anywhere: Section 9 (Warranties) is limited to corporate authority representations and the Globix carve-out, and Section 10 (General Provisions) covers only notices, relationship, assignment, waiver, governing law, severability, survival, entire agreement and headings. There is therefore no HDI indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims arising from the Site development/hosting work or for HDI's own misconduct, which is walk-away territory under INDEMN. We insert the preferred HDI indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, data breach caused by HDI, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with a notice/control/cooperation procedure, and a narrow reciprocal Company indemnity confined to our Content and our breach of law, placed at the end of Section 9 so it sits within the surviving warranty section without collateral renumbering.

ops.text: Indemnification. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (1) an allegation that the Site or the Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (2) HDI's breach of applicable law; (3) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Content or user information caused by HDI; or (4) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The Company shall give HDI prompt written notice of any such claim, HDI shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim, and the Company shall provide reasonable cooperation in the defense. The Company shall indemnify HDI against third-party claims to the extent arising out of Content provided by the Company or the Company's breach of applicable law.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added our preferred position: HDI defends and indemnifies us and our affiliates for third-party IP infringement claims, HDI's breach of law, data breaches caused by HDI, and HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure and our reciprocal indemnity kept narrow (our Content and our breach of law).
proposal.summary: Insert HDI indemnity (IP, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with claim procedure and a narrow Company indemnity, at the end of Section 9 (Warranties).

Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.

The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
